facts.fact: INSA's Director General said the House of People's Representatives unanimously ratified Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Proclamation No. 1426/2026, which sets 18 obligations for owners of 12 critical sectors, and that institutions are to use a transition period to prepare for compliance, so it is passed and not yet shown in force; the document gives no ratification date, so the date is its publication date, 2026-08-07.

systems.owner: House of People's Representatives; enforced by INSA

note: No use of the law is stated; INSA is described as preparing guidelines during the transition period.
